# 觀音經普門品重頌

**ID:** X0646
**Volume:** X35
**Category:** 法華部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／法華部疏
**Byline:** 宋 遵式述
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0646

## Contributors
- 遵式 (A001832)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* commentary on the verse portion (*chóngsòng* 重頌, *gāthā*-restatement) of the *Pǔmén pǐn* 普門品 — chapter 25 of the Lotus Sūtra ([KR6d0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0001), T262), the *Avalokiteśvara* chapter — by [遵式](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%B5%E5%BC%8F) Zūnshì (964–1032), the central figure of the Northern-Sòng Tiāntái-Pure Land synthesis at the Tiānzhúsì 天竺寺 in Hángzhōu. The work is preserved as X35n0646 in the *Xùzàngjīng* and is signed in the body *Sòng Tiānzhúsì shāmén Zūnshì shù* 宋天竺寺沙門　遵式　述.

**Abstract**

The *Chóngsòng* commentary addresses a specific textual gap in the Tiāntái Lotus commentarial tradition: [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80) Kumārajīva's translation of the Lotus omitted the verse portion of the *Pǔmén* chapter, which was supplied only later from [闍那崛多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E5%B4%9B%E5%A4%9A) Jñānagupta's *Tiānpǐn miàofǎ liánhuá jīng* ([KR6d0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0003), T264) and inserted into the standard received Lotus text. As a consequence, [智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) Zhìyǐ's *Pǔmén* commentaries (the *Xuányì* [KR6d0046](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0046) and the *Yìshū* [KR6d0048](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0048)) — composed before this insertion was widely circulated — do not provide doctrinal exposition of the verses. Zūnshì's *Chóngsòng* fills this gap, providing the standard Tiāntái doctrinal interpretation of the verse portion of the *Pǔmén* in 26 verses (twenty-six *jié* 偈, divided into one introductory verse of paired questions and twenty-five verses of paired answers).

The work is consequently of substantial textual-historical importance: it documents the late-Sòng Tiāntái awareness of the *Pǔmén* verse-portion's late textual provenance and provides the doctrinally standard Tiāntái commentary on the supplemented material. Zūnshì's editorial framing — citing the *Línggǎn zhuàn* ([靈感傳](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Titles/%E9%9D%88%E6%84%9F%E5%82%B3)) and the heavenly-voice tradition associated with Nánshān [道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3) Dàoxuān — also documents the Sòng Tiāntái awareness of the textual-historical complexity of the Lotus Sūtra and the willingness of the Sòng tradition to engage critically with the relation between Kumārajīva's translation and the supplementary material.

The composition is dated to Zūnshì's mature productive period at Tiānzhúsì in Hángzhōu, c. 996–1032.
